sources.title: Tonga Passport Act, Chapter 10.03 (2020 Revised Edition)
sources.publisher: Attorney General's Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: The Attorney General's Office hosts the current revised Passport Act. It defines the Tongan National Passport as the Part IV document and distinguishes it from a Tongan Protected Person Passport and certificates of identity.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tongan National Passport means a document issued under Part IV of this Act.

sources.title: Tonga Passport Regulations, Chapter 25.08.1 (2016 Revised Edition)
sources.publisher: Attorney General's Office, Kingdom of Tonga
sources.officialityEvidence: The Attorney General's Office hosts the operative passport regulations, which separately provide normal ten-year passport issuance and emergency-document fees.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Fee for any Passport issued at first instance in Tonga for 10 years.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: eligibility and electronic delivery
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity and online-visa purpose are anchored by the current Government Information and Press Office announcement that directs visitors to this exact domain. Its FAQ supplies the all-nationality scope and emailed/PDF issuance mechanics.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E-Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: regular-passport application process
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity is anchored by the live Government announcement linking to this exact service. Its current process requires the travel passport to match the application and excludes non-regular travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The only travel document that can be used ... is your regular passport.

policies.title: Tongan national passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service accepts citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Use the regular Tongan National Passport, rather than a protected-person, emergency or other special travel document. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days, with the source's stated passport-validity and supporting-document requirements.
Apply online, upload documents and pay. The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. Its current all-country service document does not identify a Tongan National Passport exception; this classification is therefore medium confidence. Work, residence, special documents, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service tourism eVisa
steps: Apply online with the regular Tongan National Passport and required tourism documents.
Pay and obtain the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the certificate and required documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Tongan national passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email as a PDF before travel.
conditions: Use the same valid regular Tongan National Passport for application and travel; non-regular travel documents are not accepted.

Apply through the authenticated eVisa service and receive the eVisa by email in PDF form before travel. The final visa-on-arrival stamp mentioned for arrival does not alter the pre-travel electronic issuance.
The ordinary visitor route does not establish work, residence, special-document, carrier or final-admission entitlement.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea eVisa service
steps: Apply online using the regular Tongan National Passport for travel.
Receive and retain the emailed PDF eVisa before departure.
Present the same passport and eVisa at arrival for immigration processing and final admission.
